note: Salt Valley reservoir (740 acres) northwest of Emerald, ~12 mi W of Lincoln off I-80 exit 388. Lake View Campground is a shady modern loop north of the lake with paved 50-amp pads; basic and equestrian sites elsewhere in the park. Showers and modern restrooms; four boat docks. --Claude
